subject: general
question: An egg seller buys eggs at 9 for Rs. 20, and sells them at 11 for Rs. 28. Find his profit or loss percentage (rounded off to two decimal places).
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (CP) of 9 eggs = Rs. 20

Selling price (SP) of 11 eggs = Rs. 28

**Formula Used:**

Profit or Loss% = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100%

**Calculation:**

CP of 1 egg = 20/9

SP of 1 egg = 28/11

CP of 11 eggs = 11 × (20/9) = Rs. 24.44 (approx)

SP of 11 eggs = 11 × (28/11) = Rs. 28

Using the formula,

⇒ Profit % = ((28 - 24.44)/24.44) × 100%

⇒ Profit % = 14.55% (approx)

**∴ The profit percentage is approximately 14.55%.**
